remarks: Seeking affordable living in Stamford? Look no further! Discover 90 W. Broad St. Unit 96-where city living meets affordability. This townhouse-style unit, situated within a commercial building, features three bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and an open-concept layout on the first floor. The kitchen has been recently updated with brand-new flooring. Enjoy the convenience of a designated parking space right behind the house. Located close to medical facilities, shopping centers, the train station, bus lines, and a variety of restaurants and public amenities, this home gives everything you need to make the most of living in Stamford.
